title: THE AUREATE QUILL: Celebrating Five Decades of Excellence, Creativity and Learning
paragraphs:
As Montessori Group of Institutions proudly commemorates its Golden Jubilee – 50 Glorious Years of Educational Excellence, the Montessori English Club is delighted to present the first edition of its English Club Magazine, “The Aureate Quill” – From Golden Roots to Glorious Heights. This magazine is a celebration of the institution’s rich legacy, the creative spirit of its students, the dedication of its teachers, and the values that have guided generations of Montessorians. It brings together literary creativity, imagination, knowledge, expression and the vibrant voices of our young learners. The presence of our distinguished Chief Guests makes this occasion even more meaningful. We are honoured by the presence of our esteemed Chief Guests:

Mrs. Azra Javed Garu – Secretary & Correspondent, Osmania College, Kurnool
Mr. Bankin Garu – Retd. Professor in English, Gooty
Mr. Viswanath Gopalan Garu – Academic Professional, Chrysalis

Their gracious presence makes this memorable Golden Jubilee occasion even more special.
